row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Jack Henry sells banking platforms (Banno digital banking, SilverLake/Symitar cores) to banks and credit unions through sales only, and its public developer docs (jackhenry.dev) document no SCIM endpoint or staff-user provisioning.
row.notes: Banking-technology vendor for community and regional banks and credit unions; no public pricing or plans (contact sales). Product documentation for clients sits behind the client login, so the public record is thin. jackhenry.dev documents the Banno Admin API (OAuth client credentials with a JWT key pair, configured in Banno's Users & Groups app), but its user endpoints cover consumer (accountholder) users, not back-office staff. No SCIM, staff SSO or provisioning docs, and no Okta OIN or Entra gallery app, were found. Left unknown rather than none because the client documentation could not be searched.

user_api.notes: The Banno Admin API (REST, OAuth client credentials) automates Banno back-office tasks, but its documented user resources are consumer (accountholder) users; no endpoints for back-office staff accounts were found.

limitations.text: Admin API user endpoints read data about consumer users (bank customers), not staff.
Admin API clients authenticate with OAuth client credentials; the public key is registered in Banno's Users & Groups app.
